We apply modern capabilities, including AI/ML, cloud, cybersecurity, and IT modernization to solve complex challenges, enable faster and more secure operations, and drive measurable mission outcomes.

 Location: Remote

 Terms: Full-time

 Salary Range: $90-103k DoE

 Revolutional delivers advanced technology solutions and mission support to federal agencies across civilian, health, and national security environments. We apply modern capabilities, including AI/ML, cloud, cybersecurity, and IT modernization to solve complex challenges, enable faster and more secure operations, and drive measurable mission outcomes.

 We are redefining how federal technology gets built and delivered by operating with a product mindset, prioritizing speed, ownership, and execution over bureaucracy.

 Position Description 

 Revolutional is seeking a skilled SQL Developer to design, develop, and optimize secure, high-performance database solutions supporting mission-critical federal applications.

 In this hands-on role, you will work across database development, performance optimization, and cloud modernization initiatives, including the migration of legacy databases to AWS RDS and Aurora PostgreSQL. You will collaborate with application developers, infrastructure engineers, and security teams to deliver reliable, scalable data solutions that meet federal security and governance requirements.

 The ideal candidate combines strong SQL development expertise with a problem-solving mindset, attention to performance, and the ability to improve and modernize complex database environments.

 Responsibilities 

 
 Design, develop, and optimize complex SQL queries, stored procedures, functions, and views to support enterprise applications and data processing requirements.

 Analyze database performance, troubleshoot bottlenecks, and implement improvements to query efficiency, scalability, and reliability.

 Support database modernization and migration initiatives, including transitioning legacy databases to AWS RDS and Aurora PostgreSQL.

 Collaborate with application developers to integrate database functionality, optimize data access, and support application performance.

 Implement database security best practices, including access controls, data protection, and compliance with federal security and governance standards.

 Troubleshoot and resolve database issues across development, testing, and production environments.

 Develop and maintain technical documentation, including data dictionaries, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and operational runbooks.

 Participate in code reviews, promote database development standards, and provide technical guidance to junior developers.

 Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support continuous improvement, system reliability, and modernization objectives.

 
 Technical Environment 

 
 Database Technologies: PostgreSQL, SQL, relational database management systems

 Cloud Platforms: AWS RDS, Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL

 Development: SQL queries, stored procedures, functions, views, query optimization

 Security: Database access controls, data protection, federal security and governance standards

 Delivery Practices: Database migrations, performance tuning, CI/CD, Agile development

 
 What You Bring (Requirements) 

 Baseline Requirements

 
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent certifications and professional experience.

 3+ years of hands-on SQL development experience supporting enterprise applications or database environments.

 Experience working in federal government, government contracting, or similarly regulated environments.

 U.S. Citizenship required.

 Ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance.

 
 Technical Capabilities 

 
 Strong proficiency in SQL development, including complex queries, stored procedures, functions, views, and performance optimization.

 Experience troubleshooting database performance issues and optimizing data processing efficiency.

 Understanding of relational database design, data integrity, and database development best practices.

 Knowledge of database security, access controls, and data governance requirements.

 Experience collaborating with application development, infrastructure, and security teams.

 Ability to develop clear technical documentation supporting system maintenance, operational continuity, and compliance.

 
 Core Strengths 

 
 Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to resolve complex technical challenges.

 Hands-on, detail-oriented approach to database development and performance improvement.

 Strong ownership and accountability for code quality, reliability, and delivery.

 Effective communication and collaboration across technical teams.

 Ability to manage competing priorities in a deadline-driven environment.

 
 Nice to Have (Differentiators) 

 
 Experience migrating legacy databases to AWS RDS or Aurora PostgreSQL.

 Experience with Oracle, Microsoft SQL Server, MySQL, or other relational database platforms.

 Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, database deployment automation, and DevOps practices.

 Experience with ServiceNow or similar IT service management platforms.

 Experience working within Agile or Scrum development teams.
